mentalModelCheck.question: In Erlang, how does the compiler treat two functions named fetch/1 and fetch/2 declared in the same module?

options.label: As two completely distinct functions that happen to share a name prefix
options.explanation: Function identity in Erlang is strictly the pair Name/Arity. fetch/1 and fetch/2 are separate functions.

options.label: As a single overloaded function where arity 1 provides an optional second parameter defaulted to undefined
options.explanation: Erlang has no automatic optional parameter mechanism; default parameters must be implemented explicitly via delegation.

options.label: The compiler issues a duplicate_function warning and ignores fetch/1
options.explanation: They have different arities, so there is no duplicate name collision.
